_about: Who uploaded a file, when someone shared it on another student's behalf (or when the upload came from an account that can't be linked to a student). Each rule gives 'uploadedBy' (the uploader's registered student number) and either an 'id' (a file ID, or the start of one) or a 'path' (one file, or a folder ending in /). The most specific match wins. The student number in the file's ID is the student the file belongs to.
